query:
INSERT INTO job_events (job_id, run_number, attempt, event_type, payload)
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'RETRY_SCHEDULED',
            jsonb_build_object(
                'kind', 'LEASE_EXPIRED',
                'retry_delay_ms', $4::int4,
                'next_run_at', $5::timestamptz,
                'started_without_renewal_heartbeat', $6::bool
            )
         )
